description_en: Checks whether one or more alerts are generated on a specified server based on alert IDs
description_zh: 验证一个或多个告警事件ID是否属于指定服务器
name: CheckSecurityEventId

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server.

You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers
parameters.help_zh:
要验证的服务器UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of alert events. You can specify up to 100 IDs. If you do not specify this parameter, the value of the response parameter Data is false. The value false indicates that no alert events are generated on the server.

You can call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to query the IDs of alert events
parameters.help_zh:
要验证的告警事件ID。最多支持设置100个告警事件ID。该参数为空，验证结果Data默认为false（不属于）。
调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: security_event_ids

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert events are generated on the server. Valid values:

true
false: no
Data.description_zh:
告警事件ID是否属于指定服务器。取值：
true：属于
false：不属于

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
